findings.note: 2016 vs form 2019; S7 'He further stated' follows 'The subject stated' (the driver was released). The explanation's basis ('only one person of interest') is acceptable.

Rests on the form's B2 and S5, the 2009 FIRST entry. The last entry (S7, 2017) was without inspection and supports the selected charge; the real issue is the form's manner field, which was not flagged.
Never admitted (explicit) vs a charge requiring admission.
Completed removal in the subject's own records vs NEGATIVE.
No manner stated; form blank. Citation 'needs_human_review' (requirement unestablished) is appropriate.
The ground is stated ('charged under 8 U.S.C. 1326 as an alien found … after removal'); the sentence splitter cut it after 'U.S.' and the detector saw no section.

S15 is the split-off charge clause '1326 as an alien found in the United States after removal' (legal charge wording), read as a prior removal of the subject. The subject's checks and statement explicitly show no removal.
B2 admission vs a charge for entry without admission.
'The subject' designated among three people; 2015 vs 2017.
Del Rio, Texas vs Calexico, CA.
'carried no papers of any kind' is a statement that there were no documents (satisfies N1).
'Neither man carried identification' is a statement that there were none.
'He presented a Honduran identity card' states the document presented; the document pattern lacks 'identity card'.
The cousin's relayed 'he was deported' has two possible referents; the extraction itself marked it person 'other'. Asserting a conflict with the subject's record is unsupported (routing it is right).
Two unexplained accounts of the same entry; review-marked.
The narrative mentions that his border crossing card had expired but does not say which identity documents he had or presented at the encounter.

citationVerdicts.note: The model reported the mismatch; the rule treated the misread charge clause (S15) as a verified prior removal and qualified it. Expected likely_mismatch.
An in-absentia removal ORDER is not a completed removal; the records say execution is not shown. Expected needs_human_review or insufficient_information, and routing.
The charge depends on manner, which is stated and uncontested; the qualification rests on the date conflict.
Rests on the model's claim that the charge 'relies on entry place'.
